content: Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of quinidine by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. It is recommended to avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Close monitoring is advised. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of quinine through its impact on CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution is advised, and close monitoring is necessary. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of quizartinib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Close monitoring is required. Rifabutin lowers the levels or effects of rabeprazole by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of raltegravir by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution is advised, and close monitoring is necessary. Additionally, rifabutin induces UGT1A1, requiring close monitoring. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of ramelteon by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Close monitoring is required. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of ranolazine by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin and regorafenib are contraindicated due to their effects on CYP3A4 metabolism. Strong CYP3A4 inducers decrease regorafenib levels while increasing exposure to its active metabolite M-5. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of repaglinide by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of repotrectinib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of ribociclib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Ribociclib, in turn, increases rifabutin levels by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution is advised, and close monitoring is necessary. Rifampin decreases the levels or effects of rifabutin by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Rifapentine reduces the levels or effects of rifabutin by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin decreases the levels of rilpivirine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. If coadministered, increase rilpivirine dose to 50 mg once daily, and reduce to 25 mg once daily after stopping rifabutin. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of rimegepant by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of riociguat by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. Dose adjustment data is unavailable. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of ripretinib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Co-administration with strong CYP3A inhibitors decreases systemic exposure to ripretinib and its active metabolite (DP-5439), potentially reducing adverse reactions. Ritonavir increases rifabutin levels by decreasing its metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Close monitoring is necessary. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of rivaroxaban by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of roflumilast by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. Strong CYP450 enzyme inducers decrease systemic exposure to roflumilast, potentially reducing therapeutic effectiveness. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of rolapitant by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Long-term co-administration with strong CYP3A4 inducers may significantly reduce rolapitant efficacy. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of romidepsin by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Co-administration with strong CYP3A4 inducers should be avoided if possible. Rucaparib increases rifabutin levels by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. Adjust dosages of CYP3A4 substrates if clinically indicated. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of ruxolitinib topical by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is unknown, but close monitoring is advised. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of saxagliptin by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of selpercatinib by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of selumetinib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of sildenafil by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Potent CYP3A4 inducers are expected to cause substantial decreases in sildenafil plasma levels. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of silodosin by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of simvastatin by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of siponimod by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Co-administration with moderate CYP2C9 and moderate/strong CYP3A4 inducers is not recommended. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of sirolimus by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of sofosbuvir by affecting P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. P-gp inducers decrease sofosbuvir levels, reducing conversion to its active metabolite (GS-331007), responsible for 90% of its pharmacologic effect. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of sofosbuvir/velpatasvir by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Velpatasvir is a substrate of CYP2B6, CYP2C8, and CYP3A4. Moderate-to-potent inducers of these enzymes may significantly reduce velpatasvir plasma concentrations, potentially reducing therapeutic effect. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of solifenacin by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of sonidegib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Co-administration with strong or moderate CYP3A4 inducers should be avoided. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of sorafenib by increasing its metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of sotorasib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of stiripentol by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. If co-administration is unavoidable, increase the stiripentol dose and monitor closely. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of sufentanil by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Co-administration of CYP3A4 inducers may decrease sufentanil levels and efficacy, potentially causing withdrawal syndrome in physically dependent patients. Discontinuation of CYP3A4 inducers may increase sufentanil plasma concentration. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of sunitinib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of suvorexant by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Strong CYP3A4 inducers may reduce suvorexant efficacy. If an increased dose is required, do not exceed 20 mg/day. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of tacrolimus by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of tadalafil by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Avoid this combination in pulmonary hypertension patients. For erectile dysfunction patients, monitor tadalafil response carefully due to potential decreased effectiveness. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of tamoxifen by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of tamsulosin by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of tasimelteon by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration with strong CYP3A4 inducers. Monitor closely. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of tazemetostat by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Monitor closely. Tecovirimat reduces rifabutin levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Tecovirimat is a weak CYP3A4 inducer. Monitor sensitive CYP3A4 substrates for effectiveness if co-administered. Rifabutin decreases temazepam levels by increasing its metabolism. The clinical significance is unknown. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of temsirolimus by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of teniposide by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of terbinafine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of tetracycline by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of tezacaftor by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of theophylline by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of tiagabine by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin decreases the levels of ticagrelor by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid using ticagrelor with potent CYP3A inducers. Monitor closely. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of tinidazole by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Tipranavir increases rifabutin levels by decreasing its metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin decreases tipranavir levels by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitor closely. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of tivozanib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of tofacitinib by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Loss of or decreased response to tofacitinib may occur when co-administered with potent CYP3A4 inducers. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of tolterodine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of tolvaptan by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin reduces the levels of toremifene by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. CYP3A4 inducers increase the rate of toremifene metabolism, lowering its steady-state serum concentration. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of trabectedin by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Monitor closely.
